responsibility: Implements basic fixed-buffer string utilities for the boot runtime, including concatenation, lexical comparison, equality, length, bounded copying, substring testing, and removal of leading whitespace. It operates directly on caller-provided character arrays with ASCII_nul termination and serves as the lightweight foundational string helper layer beneath higher abstractions such as DynamicStrings and parsing modules.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the working implementations of the fixed-buffer string primitives from GStrLib.h, including concatenation, comparison, copy, substring search, and whitespace trimming over ASCII_nul-terminated arrays. The header only declares those utilities.
